method.signal: Positions C, LW, RW, D ranked by the defending team's last-10 goals allowed to each position divided by the league average for that position (index; 1.00 = league average, higher = softer than the league). Descending; ties keep C, LW, RW, D order. WATCH is the top position. A position with no league average is indexed 0.
method.grading: Hit when the offense team scored at least one goal by a skater listed at the watched position (NHL stats API skater summary). Empty-net goals count; shootout goals do not.
method.games: Regular season and playoffs only. Picks are logged before puck drop and never changed afterwards.
